nodes.g: Ezri = "help of Jehovah" son of Chelub and superintendent of king David's farm labourers
Shiphmite = see Siphmoth "fruitful" an inhabitant of Shepham or Siphmoth
Chelub ai = "my caged one" son of Hezron of Judah;
Ramathite = see Ramah "the height" an inhabitant of Ramah
Eshton = "effeminate" a descendant of Caleb of tribe of Judah
